# Cedar Payroll

> UK payroll software and bureau services for employers, bureau staff, and employees.

Cedar Payroll Limited (trading as Cedar Payroll) provides cloud payroll, HMRC RTI, payslips, leave, attendance, and employee self-service. The same account works on the website and the iOS and Android apps.

Contact: support@cedarpayroll.com · +971 50 429 4194 · United Kingdom · Mon–Fri, 9:00–17:30
